**Mismatches:**

1.  **Pose Name vs. Description:** The name "Soft Standing Back Bend" describes a standing pose, but the description explicitly says to "Lie on one side." These are contradictory.
2.  **Description vs. Visible Figure:** The figure is **standing upright with arms raised**, while the description details a **side-lying pose** (pressing up on a forearm and extending the top leg).
3.  **Pose Name vs. Visible Figure:** While both imply a vertical orientation, "Back Bend" implies an arching of the spine backward, whereas the visible figure is in a straight, neutral standing position.

**Conclusion:** There are significant mismatches between all three elements (Name, Description, and Image).
